label: body
__line_text__: From fairest creatures we desire increase,

label: body
__line_text__: That thereby beauty’s rose might never die,

label: body
__line_text__: But as the riper should by time decease,

label: body
__line_text__: His tender heir might bear his memory:

label: body
__line_text__: But thou contracted to thine own bright eyes,

label: body
__line_text__: Feed’st thy light’s flame with self-substantial fuel,

label: body
__line_text__: Making a famine where abundance lies,

label: body
__line_text__: Thyself thy foe, to thy sweet self too cruel:

label: body
__line_text__: Thou that art now the world’s fresh ornament,

label: body
__line_text__: And only herald to the gaudy spring,

label: body
__line_text__: Within thine own bud buriest thy content,

label: body
__line_text__: And, tender churl, mak’st waste in niggarding:

label: body
__line_text__: Pity the world, or else this glutton be,

label: body
__line_text__: To eat the world’s due, by the grave and thee.

label: body
__line_text__: When forty winters shall besiege thy brow,

label: body
__line_text__: And dig deep trenches in thy beauty’s field,

label: body
__line_text__: Thy youth’s proud livery so gazed on now,

label: body
__line_text__: Will be a tattered weed of small worth held:

label: body
__line_text__: Then being asked, where all thy beauty lies,

label: body
__line_text__: Where all the treasure of thy lusty days;

label: body
__line_text__: To say, within thine own deep sunken eyes,

label: body
__line_text__: Were an all-eating shame, and thriftless praise.

label: body
__line_text__: How much more praise deserv’d thy beauty’s use,

label: body
__line_text__: If thou couldst answer ‘This fair child of mine

label: body
__line_text__: Shall sum my count, and make my old excuse,’

label: body
__line_text__: Proving his beauty by succession thine.
